title: young sweet jelly portuguese kid-friendly dessert cake
description: A traditional portuguese dessert featuring a sweet and tangy jelly topping, perfect for kids.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix together the almond flour, coconut sugar, date syrup, apple cider vinegar, red wine vinegar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Knead the mixture for 10 minutes until it forms a smooth dough.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and place it in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake the cake for 25 minutes or until it is lightly golden brown.
While the cake is baking, prepare the jelly topping by mixing together the apple cider vinegar, red wine vinegar, and 1 cup of water in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat and then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Spread the jelly topping over the warm cake.
